query: Периодически выбирай новые записи из PostgreSQL public.orders и сохраняй их в JSON-файл /data/output/orders_export.json.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: pg_orders_to_json
  name: PostgreSQL Orders to JSON Export
  description: Periodically extracts new records from PostgreSQL public.orders and
    saves them to a JSON file.
triggers:
- id: trigger_schedule
  type: schedule
  condition: every 1 hour
sources:
- id: source_pg
  name: Read Orders
  type: PostgreSQL
  location: public.orders
  connection:
    properties:
      host: '{{DB_HOST}}'
      port: '{{DB_PORT}}'
      database: '{{DB_NAME}}'
      username: '{{DB_USERNAME}}'
      password: '{{DB_PASSWORD}}'
processing_elements:
- id: process_filter_new
  name: Filter New Records
  operation: Filter
  config:
    condition: created_at > {{LAST_RUN_TIMESTAMP}}
sinks:
- id: sink_json
  name: Write JSON File
  type: File
  location: /data/output/orders_export.json
processed_data:
- id: orders_json
  format: json
links:
- from_id: source_pg
  to_id: process_filter_new
  data_ref: orders_json
- from_id: process_filter_new
  to_id: sink_json
  data_ref: orders_json
